common.tagline: AI drafts the map. You craft the learning.

topbar.installSafariGuide: On Mac Safari: click 'File' in the top menu bar -> 'Add to Dock' to install MapCraft as a standalone desktop app!

settings.title: Settings & LLM Connections
settings.subtitle: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK). All credentials remain on your device and are never sent to third-party servers.
settings.storageModeSession: Session Storage (Cleared when browser is closed)
settings.storageModeMemory: Memory Only (Cleared on page refresh, recommended on public PCs)
settings.storageModeNotice: Privacy note: Keys are stored exclusively in your browser and sent directly to your chosen Base URL. On shared devices, Memory Only is strongly advised.
settings.mapModelLabel: Map Planning Model (Prefers speed and cost-efficiency)
settings.lessonModelLabel: Lesson Generation Model (Prefers depth and reasoning)
settings.customModelPlaceholder: Or type custom model ID (e.g., gemini-3.8-flash)
settings.fetchModelsFailed: Failed to auto-fetch models. Please check your key or enter model ID manually.
settings.selectModelPlaceholder: Select a recommended or available model...
settings.ollamaNotice: Local Ollama tip: Make sure Ollama is running with OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*" to allow direct browser requests.
settings.dataSubtitle: All maps, progress, and lesson caches are stored locally in your browser IndexedDB.
settings.clearLessonsDesc: Free up storage space. This will only clear generated AI note caches; map structures and completion progress are safely preserved. Lessons can be regenerated anytime.
settings.clearLessonsConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear cached AI lesson notes? Maps and learning progress will be preserved.
settings.clearAllConfirm: Warning: This will permanently wipe all local maps, progress, lesson caches, and API key settings. This action cannot be undone. Reset now?
settings.clearAllSuccess: All local data has been reset to initial state.
